instruction: Locate the closest available time slot for Antelope Island.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the nearest open slot for Antelope Island on recreation.gov. The evaluator verifies: (1) that 'Antelope Island' was actually searched by checking URL and page content for location-specific information, (2) that availability results were found by detecting the presence of the reservation table, and (3) optionally extracts the first available date. This ensures the task was completed correctly and not just any results page was reached.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all requirements - (1) Antelope Island was searched via URL and page content checks, (2) availability results table was found, (3) optionally captures nearest available date

Correct location verification: Getter checks URL for 'antelope' keyword (lines 86-89) and searches multiple page elements (h1, title, search input, facility name) for location confirmation (lines 92-108)
Correct availability verification: Getter detects presence of camp-sortable-column-header table elements indicating availability results are displayed (lines 112-115)
Robust state extraction: Uses multiple fallback strategies to verify location (URL + 5 different HTML selectors), making verification resilient to page structure variations
Appropriate metric scoring: Metric weights location (40%) + availability (40%) + date extraction (20%), requiring 80%+ score for pass, ensuring both critical requirements are met
Correct parameter handling: Metric function properly accesses result dict fields without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules')
Task-specific validation: Expected rules (must_verify_location, must_verify_availability) align with instruction requirements and are semantically meaningful
Practical runtime feasibility: Logic will work at runtime - connects to Chrome via CDP, parses HTML with BeautifulSoup, extracts semantic information correctly
